notes: Cutnote Hub: hover Cutnote Editor at the top left and pick Cutnote Hub to see every project on your computer, each with a picture, its open notes and when you last edited it.
Switch projects in one click: open any project from the Hub and the editor reopens on it, no restart needed.
New project: name it, drop in your footage and Cutnote makes the folder and copies the footage in. Your originals stay where they are.
Rename, remove or trash: renaming only changes the name in the Hub, never the folder. Deleting asks first, and Move to Trash can always be undone from the Trash.
Watched folders: point the Hub at a folder of projects and new ones show up by themselves, including the ones your AI assistant makes.
